title: Explicit Jev token value in a Claude config

request.goal: A run-config file contains exactly {"worker_family": "claude", "max_jev_tokens": 50000}. Using only the config source, state the max_jev_tokens value of RunConfig.from_dict(that object).

config.title: scripts/config.py excerpt

pass: max_jev_tokens is 100,000. The explicit 50000 equals the default, so __post_init__ cannot tell it apart from an untouched default and doubles it.

**100000.** `from_dict` validates the keys and calls `cls(**value)`, so `worker_family="claude"` and `max_jev_tokens=50000` are set, then `__post_init__` runs. Its branch tests the value (`if self.max_jev_tokens == 50000`), so the explicit 50000 is rewritten to 100000.
fail: It stays 50000, because the value was set explicitly and only an untouched default doubles.
It stays 50000; it would only become 100000 if the default were untouched.
